OKC will be eligible for a hardship exception with Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace & Jalen Williams out long-term.

Challenge is that a hardship exception is a roster exception, not a cap exception. After signing Ochai Agbaji, OKC will be only about $4.6M under the second apron.

items.title: This is Chet Holmgren's 5th NBA season.
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
This is Chet Holmgren's 5th NBA season.

He missed his entire rookie season due to foot injury suffered in August in Seattle

Missed most of championship season after crash landing in November of that year

He's going to miss most of the next two months due to a knee issue diagnosed before Halloween
